model_visible.title: meta-data 110
model_visible.intro: 这是一道元谜题。题面只有喂入词和原题留下的说明。用 submit_answer 提交答案。不要打开其他网站。

static.prompt:
The 9 teams in this conference have developed an interesting method of communication. Can you figure out what their secret is?
喂入词：
VICTORY CELEBRATION
THE HITCHHIKER'S GUIDE TO THE GALAXY
NUMBER ONE SINGLE
LOCKS HORNS
PEACE BE WITH YOU
GAME BIRD
OK CORRAL
NEW YORK I LOVE YOU BUT YOU'RE BRINGING ME DOWN
SECOND PLACE IS THE FIRST LOSER
用 submit_answer 提交一个答案。

notes_for_report: 来自 GPH 2017。答案只在裁判哈希里。完整数据文件不交给模型。
